svg.text: Seed3 socket (jumper ends in the right wall), seen from INSIDE, USB-C end on your LEFT
PG-1 wiring, page 6 of 10: The 3 footswitches -> Seed3
Either lug of each footswitch to its Seed3 place; the other lug is on the ground-chain page.
Steps (the number is on the wire):
pg-a: either lug -> Seed3 socket place 24 (bottom row)
pg-b: either lug -> Seed3 socket place 25 (bottom row)
pg-c: either lug -> Seed3 socket place 10 (top row)
